mechanism: Fast vs slow iMA cross (past fast>slow and current fast<slow → sell; opposite → buy) gated by KVO signal buffer: only sell when kvoSignal<0, only buy when kvoSignal>0. Places virtual binary-option trades via PlaceTrade on the chart TF.

mechanism: LBR/RSI = RSI(period≈3) of ROC where ROC[i]=price[i]−price[i−2] (skip one bar). On closed D1 bar: value < oversold(30) → buy-day regime; > overbought(70) → sell-day; else no trade. Sets allowed trade direction for the next calendar day.
data_needed: D1 OHLC (or median/typical/weighted); RSI period; OB/OS levels; iCustom LBR_RSI buffer 4.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY H1, EURUSD H1, XAUUSD H1 backtests from 2014; signal on D1, execution levels from H1
why_new_for_mis: ROC-of-skip-1 then short RSI as a daily buy/sell/neutral regime label is a compact overnight directional sensor MIS can attach before intraday entries.
quote: On D1, the value of LBR/RSI of the last closed day should be within the oversold area - below 30.

mechanism: After LBR/RSI sets day direction, wait for first H1 bar of the day to close; place BuyStop above that bar High (+entry offset) or SellStop below Low (−offset); SL on opposite side of first-hour range. Optional exits: trail, close on next day’s first H1 close, or break of prior day High/Low.
data_needed: PERIOD_H1 rates for today’s first bar; D1 LBR/RSI direction; entry/exit offsets in points.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY/EURUSD/XAUUSD; D1+H1 hybrid; demo MetaQuotes from 2014

quote: After closing the first hourly bar of a new day, place the pending buy order higher than that bar maximum.

mechanism: Each new day: PP=(H+L+C)/3 from prior D1; RES1=2*PP−L, SUP1=2*PP−H; RES2=PP+(H−L), SUP2=PP−(H−L); RES3/SUP3 and mid levels 0.5/1.5/2.5 as midpoints. Horizontal buffer levels for the active day define the support/resistance regime map.
data_needed: Prior D1 high/low/close; optional plot flags per level; working TF bars for buffer fill.

quote: PP = (HIGH + LOW + CLOSE) / 3 … RES1.0 = 2*PP - LOW … SUP1.0 = 2*PP – HIGH

mechanism: Pattern 0: if day Open above PP and bar Low touches PP within PointsNear → buy; if Open below PP and High touches PP → sell (later inverted variants). SL/TP bound to MinorSupport/MajorResistance (or swapped). One pattern per day; unfinished positions closed at new day.
data_needed: Daily open; current PP; prior-bar high/low; m_pnt_near tolerance; pivot buffers.

mechanism: MaTrendCatcher: compare fast vs slow MA; histogram = +1 bull / −1 bear; bar green if |spread| increased vs prior bar (acceleration), else red. Cutoff hides bars when |fast−slow| is insignificant (flat). Sub-pattern adds/subtracts weight for trend±accel; lot ∝ |weighted direction|/100.
data_needed: Fast/slow MA periods; Cutoff in points; prior bar trend value and color buffers.

quote: If the difference between them is positive, the trend is bullish… if the difference between MAs is insignificant, the bars are not displayed.

mechanism: Width limit: if MajorResistance(0) < PP+wid_limit or MajorSupport(0) > PP−wid_limit, Pattern 0 is marked done (no trade)—skips days when RES1–SUP1 band is too narrow (low expected range).
